# Magic Engine

> Magic Engine is an AI growth engine for Australian and New Zealand businesses. It connects discovery, analysis, recommended actions, execution and outcome tracking.

## Core product

- [AI Growth Engine](https://magicengine.com.au/ai-growth-engine): how the Magic Engine operating loop works
- [Free Growth Diagnosis](https://magicengine.com.au/discover): identify the most useful next growth action
- [AI Adoption and Training](https://magicengine.com.au/training): practical AI rollout for AU/NZ teams
- [GEO and AI Visibility](https://magicengine.com.au/geo): help search and AI systems understand and recommend a business

## Industry solutions

- [Industry Solutions](https://magicengine.com.au/industry-solutions): compare purpose-built growth systems by industry and customer journey
- [Real Estate](https://magicengine.com.au/real-estate): audience growth for agents and brand/project demand for developers
- [Travel](https://magicengine.com.au/travel): content, SEO, GEO, paid demand, effective leads and CRM conversion
- [Local Services](https://magicengine.com.au/local-services): local visibility, reputation, enquiries and follow-up

## Product principles

- Magic Engine is a growth and execution layer, not a forced replacement for every CRM or website.
- Anonymous advertising audiences are not represented as identifiable people.
- Raw audience and contact data is never transferred between clients.
- Funnel stages are reported as known, unknown or connected; missing outcomes are not inferred.
- Public claims should be grounded in client-provided facts or traceable source data.

## Markets and languages

Magic Engine is designed for Australia and New Zealand. Delivery supports English and Chinese-speaking teams.
